scope: Conditional finite Gaussian source observations and actual thickness homotheties. This tests blur-frame transport and retains finite-model error separately; it is not physical calibration, exact finite-shape inference or a whole-photo accuracy claim.

blur.sigma: det(Sigma)**0.25 in the original measurement frame

oracle.method: Independent finite area slices with standard-library erfc, targeted circle/conditional-normal breakpoints and cosine endpoint substitution. A finite capsule is a rectangle plus two disjoint half-disks.

criteria.mixed_policy: Retain existing explicitly marked legacy approximations; do not require a physical truth recovery or invent a common covariance.
criteria.finite_bias_policy: Report actual radius/centre error against the supplied finite shape without imposing recovery/improvement criteria; transport consistency is distinct from approximation accuracy.

adverse_no_halflevel.policy: Record centre mass below one half and no half-level contour; never manufacture source observations.

limitations: Pose, Gaussian covariance, source shape and brightness normalization are supplied, not estimated.
Uniform rotations reuse the same independently integrated source via exact orthogonal change of coordinates.
Circles use uniformly spaced radial directions, not a claim of uniform arc-length sampling.
Capsule fits use independently known side directions and point-bound spans, followed by actual line refitting and cap fitting.
Free-arc controls test stored radius/centre transport on a known disk sector; they do not claim canonical join/export consistency.
Mixed controls use actual piecewise thickness maps and test explicit diagnostic behavior, not a stationary Gaussian inference.
Quadrature-order agreement is numerical evidence, not a certified probability enclosure.
No segmentation, camera response/noise estimation, source image processing, real capture or physical fit is qualified.
